dct_description_sm: The data set was developed with the main intention of improving the health of young children in Canadian Arctic communities in partnership with local health authorities and parents/guardians. Specifically, our group quantified the burden of enteric infections among pre-school aged children in Nunavik and Nunavut, and measured the impact of diarrhea/enteric pathogens on their growth and development. We also evaluated the impact of local diagnostics for enteric infections in these regions. Together this data will help inform subsequent community-adapted interventions that seek to prevent enteric infections and help children reach their full potential.

dct_title_s: Diarrheal illness and enteric infections among young children in Nunavik and Nunavut: a 2-year prospective cohort study
